description: The audit-repair and worker-session roots through main() on a labelled disposable PostgreSQL (one fresh schema, no mask): audit-repair status, inspect (with and without a task id), enable and disable on an unknown audit and enable of a seeded task whose audit is unknown (M7's refusal shapes); worker-session status of an unknown task, of a seeded task without a session and with no task id (a bounded status), and close of an unknown and of a seeded task (M7's refusals); stdout, stderr and exit code per case
